Hey everyone, 

Thanks to the nimble team for a great software and for providing a forum where we can ask questions. I am trying to implement a nimble function that produces emergence probabilities from a normal distribution with mean (mu) and standard deviation (sigma) in my nimble model. When compiling I encounter the error: failed to create the shared library.  My code for the nimble function is :

nimbetas_fun = nimbleFunction(
  run = function(Y =double(0), TT = double(0), mu = double(1), sigma= double(1)){
    returnType(double(3)) 
    betas <- nimArray(0, c(Y, TT, 4))
    for(y in 1:Y)
    {
      for(c in 1:4)
      {
        betas[y, ,c] <- c(pnorm(1, mu[c], sigma[c]), pnorm(2:(TT-1), mu[c], sigma[c]) - pnorm(1:(TT-2), mu[c], sigma[c]), 1 - pnorm(TT-1, mu[c], sigma[c]))
      }
    }
    
    return(betas)
  }
)

This function should take create an array of emergence probabilities where mu and sigma are vectors. The implementation of  this function in my nimble model is as follows:


cbetas[1:Y,1:TT ,1:4] <- nimbetas_fun(Y,TT, mu = mu[1:4], sigma= sigma[1:4])  
  
  for (y in 1:Y) {
    
    for (c in 1:4) {
      
      E[y,1:TT,c] ~ dmulti(cbetas[y,1:TT,c], N[y,c])
      
    }
  }

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Failed to create the shared library
parts:
Hmm, it looks like there may be a bug related to types somewhat deep in our compilation system where we check that the lengths of the vectors you are subtracting are the same. 

As a work-around, please try this:

1) Add this just before your loops:
idx1 <- 2:(TT-1)
idx2 <- 1:(TT-2)

2) Then use 'idx1' and 'idx2' in the main line with the calls to pnorm():

 betas[y, ,c] <- c(pnorm(1, mu[c], sigma[c]), pnorm(idx1, mu[c], sigma[c]) - pnorm(idx2, mu[c], sigma[c]), 1 - pnorm(TT-1, mu[c], sigma[c]))

I will come up with a smaller reproducible example and file as a bug report for us to look at.

-chris
